searchIndexStaleLong: Search finds only some of the concepts on this server: of {{sampled}} concepts taken from this server's own list, search found {{found}} by their own name. Many concepts, often all the CIEL ones, will be missing from the results, so don't create a new concept just because search didn't find it. Ask a system administrator to rebuild the search index (Legacy Admin > Maintenance > Search Index > Rebuild).
searchIndexStaleShort: Search finds only some of this server's concepts, so a missing result doesn't mean the concept doesn't exist. Ask an administrator to rebuild the search index.
